title: Inside the image
description: Image markers and a compact index share one selection, revealing details without losing the whole picture.
useCase: Explain an artwork, product detail or architectural feature through precisely placed points and a linked list.
interaction: Choose a point on the print or a detail in the index
reducedMotion: Selection changes immediately; the connecting ring does not travel between points.
limitations: Hotspot coordinates assume the supplied uncropped image. Replace coordinates when replacing the image. Host pause disables selection.
look: Off-white page with a Japanese woodblock landscape print marked by numbered white circular pins, beside a large dark serif title and ruled numbered list.
motion: Choosing a pin or list item glides a white ring to that point in 250 ms ease-out; the chosen pin darkens and scales to 112% in 180 ms.
adapt: `selected` drives both the `pin` buttons and the `crosshair`. A full-size positioning layer translates to the selected percentage coordinates over 250 ms, carrying a fixed-size ring without animating layout. Replace `details` (names, percentage `x` and `y` coordinates, text) together with the image, since coordinates assume the uncropped artwork.
